field.comment: At strength 1 an isolated control's nominal half-axes describe its isosurface. Positive finite support only; no negative grooves, noise, floor or global height mask.

meshing.comment: One shared-edge tetrahedral extraction and one Blender collapse only. Flat faces; no smoothing, subdivision, cap, repeated repair or automatic camera fitting.
